# Three.js r170 (0.170.0)

Official MIT-licensed ESM distribution. `scripts/fetch-web-vendor-assets.sh`
fetches the exact module at build time and checks SHA-256:
`08fd7545d13d2c7fb65ab691530a802dafefd638596501854f267d0fb13c39e7`.

The Web/PWA and APK offline package contain the same local module. Opening the
3D app does not contact a CDN. WebGL 2 is required. No npm install or separate
Web/APK implementation is necessary.

Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r170
